name: Flo & Co. Knysna
address: Thesen Harbour Town, TH33 Sawtooth Ln, Thesen Island, Knysna, 6570, South Africa
description_short: Waterfront dining on Thesen Island with coffee, breakfasts, and casual plates overlooking the harbour.
description_long:
Flo & Co. sits right on the water at Thesen Harbour Town, where the wooden boardwalks and boat moorings give you that easy-going marina vibe. It's the kind of spot where you can linger over coffee and pastries in the morning, then come back for lunch with a view of the boats drifting by. The menu covers breakfast staples, burgers, salads, and light mains that suit a relaxed harbour setting.

The location is the real draw here — outdoor tables right on the waterfront make it ideal for families, groups, or anyone wanting to soak up the Knysna harbour atmosphere without too much fuss. Service is straightforward, and the setting does most of the talking. It's a solid choice when you want decent food in a spot that feels like a proper harbour-side escape.

Thesen Island itself is worth a wander, with walking paths, shops, and views across the lagoon. Flo & Co. fits right into that laid-back island rhythm, making it a handy stop whether you're staying nearby or just exploring Knysna's waterfront precincts.
